name: cyclopts-configuration-source-diagnostics
instr:
Cyclopts cannot inspect configuration problems as structured, source-located data before running a selected command. Add inspection for JSON, TOML, and YAML without invoking the command or changing normal behavior.

Inspection returns every safely discoverable issue in provider and source order, with unlocated provider findings last. Located findings identify their source and span offending text with one-based coordinates. Report syntax errors, duplicate or conflicting definitions, and nested value locations. Preserve TOML binary input, optional dependency behavior, and safe YAML loading. Missing or unreadable sources and unavailable parsers become findings when inspection can continue.

Reconciliation reports disallowed unknown paths, conversion and validation failures, and shadowed values. Include the argument, full indexed source path, location, and original failure. Providers and CLI tokens can shadow values. Preserve command selection, lazy resolution, precedence, caching, ordinary exceptions and messages, conversion behavior, and result actions outside inspection.

`ConfigBase.diagnose` returns a `ConfigDiagnosticReport`. `ConfigDiagnosticReport.__iter__` and `ConfigDiagnosticReport.__len__` agree with `diagnostics`; `has_errors` reflects error severity. `ConfigurationDiagnosticError` is a `CycloptsError` carrying the identical report returned by non-raising inspection. `ConfigDiagnosticSeverity` is a Enum. `ConfigDiagnosticCode` is a Enum.

Two located provider values
